findings_to_judge.finding: Hanwha Vision - which signed an $800m+, 10-year, multi-generation edge-AI SoC LTA with Ambarella on 2026-05-28 - reported its security segment's best quarter ever for calendar Q2 2026 (KRW 394.6bn, +20.1% YoY vs KRW 328.4bn), with AI-CCTV rising to 59% of network-camera revenue from 46% a year earlier; that AI mix shift is exactly the content-per-camera driver behind Ambarella's professional IoT line, which is ~75% of its revenue.

The baseline's -20.07% 20-day run-up is not a fundamental de-rate: AMBA closed $69.19 on 2026-07-29, jumped +7.08% to $74.09 on 30 July and +16.08% to $86.00 on 31 July on the FT report of NXP takeover talks, and has since bled straight back to $65.43 - only 5.4% below the last undisturbed pre-rumour close, against SMH -6.6% from 7 August to 3 September. There has been no report anywhere that the NXP process ended.

Ambarella cut total manufacturing purchase commitments 33% sequentially, from $80.4m at 31-Jan-26 to $53.9m at 30-Apr-26, and booked a first-ever $1.2m adverse-purchase-commitment loss liability (it was exactly $0 the prior quarter) - while inventory rose 54% to $80.4m and days of inventory went 99 to 145, a build management told the call was precautionary against a second-half supply shortage.

A customer development project funded by a $13.5m cash advance was terminated on 12-May-26; $4.5m is refunded and the remaining $9.0m is XBRL-tagged as a forecast reduction of R&D expense in the quarter ended 31-Jul-26 - i.e. tonight's quarter - yet the 28-May press release and the earnings call both omitted it entirely while guiding Q2 non-GAAP opex to $56.0-59.0m against $56.4m actual in Q1.

The stock at $65.43 is 5.4% BELOW its pre-rumour close of $69.19 on 29-Jul-26, i.e. the entire premium from the FT's 31-Jul-26 report that NXP was in talks to buy the company for over $3bn has been erased and then some, with no report anywhere that the talks collapsed - and the -20.1% 20-session slide compares with only -6.8% for SOXX over the same span, so ~13 points of it is idiosyncratic and unattributed to any dated company news.
